NOTICEOFBOOKCLOSURE
Allshareholdersandothers areinformed thattheshare transferbooksofTRGPakistanLimited
will remain closed fromFebruary 22,2025 toFebruary 28,2025(both days inclusive).
This book closure is being made in compliance with Regulation 9 of the Listed Companies
(Substantial Acquisition of Voting Shares and Takeovers) Regulations,2017 to deterimine the
eligibilityofpersons toreceiveofferlettersinconnectionwith thePublicAnnouncement of Offer
published on January 17, 2025, in “Business Recorder” and "Nawai Waqt" newspapers, through
AKD Securities Limited, as manager to the offer, on behalf of Greentree Holdings Limited, with
respect to the acquisition of up to 35.145% shareholding and control of TRG Pakistan Limited.
Transfers received in order at the office of TRG Pakistan Limited's share registrar, Messrs. THK
Associates (Pvt.) Limited on or before close of business on February 21,2025will be considered
in time for determining the eligibility of person to receive the Offer letters.
Yours sincerely
Zeeshan ul Haq
Company Secretary
